dataset.name: Scogo AI Sovereign Enterprise NetOps — Prompt Seeds, Part 2
dataset.description: 4,010 synthetic enterprise network-operations task prompts (prompt seeds) sampled from the compositional taxonomy `scogo-enterprise-netops-v2`. Each record is a self-contained, fictional operational scenario — an incident ticket, on-call chat, CLI session, config review, change request, war room, audit, architecture review, or automation brief — carrying embedded evidence fixtures (configs, logs, telemetry, packet summaries, routing tables, topology) and a task instruction. Records are PROMPTS ONLY: there are no reference answers, no assistant messages, no tool results, and no ground-truth labels.
dataset.intended_use: Seed corpus for teacher-trajectory generation, model evaluation on enterprise NetOps reasoning, and rubric/judge development. This is stage 1 of the pipeline defined in docs/netops-data-contract.md; a schema-valid, review-accepted prompt is not a verified or trainable trajectory.
dataset.out_of_scope: Telecom / service-provider network operations (3GPP RAN, EPC, 5GC, IMS, spectrum planning, carrier OSS/BSS, carrier optical backbone) and certification-exam question generation are excluded by the taxonomy scope.
dataset.relationship_to_other_parts: Same taxonomy, same schema. Part 1 (3,500) was written by deepseek-v4-flash-0731 with mixed reviewers. Part 2 was written by cx/gpt-5.6-luna-max and reviewed plus adjudicated by cx/gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh. Part 3 (5,000) was written by deepseek-v4-flash-0731 with qwen38-nvfp4 as reviewer. Part 2 and Part 3 share coordinate_seed 20260820, so they re-walk the same coordinate sequence: 1,645 coordinate tuples are common to both, covering 2,169 Part 2 records (54.1%). Coordinate overlap with Part 1 is zero (different seeds). The parts have not been cross-deduplicated at the semantic level.

file.format: JSON Lines (one JSON object per line, UTF-8, LF line endings, trailing newline)
file.note_non_ascii: 32 distinct non-ASCII codepoints, all typographic or diagrammatic: em/en dashes (U+2014, U+2013), curly quotes (U+2019, U+201C, U+201D), arrows (U+2192, U+2194, U+21C4), bullets (U+2022), box-drawing and block characters used in embedded CLI output (U+2500, U+2502, U+2514, U+251C, U+2588), and a few math/unit/Greek symbols (≤ ≥ × ± µ ° − α β ∈). No CJK, no emoji. Normalize if a downstream tokenizer or store requires ASCII.

prompt.description: The full task text handed to a model. Self-contained: scenario framing, embedded evidence fixtures, and the instruction.

category.description: Top-level taxonomy category. Constant `enterprise_netops` in this part.

domain.description: Networking domain, e.g. layer3_routing, network_services. 25 values present.

subdomain.description: Specific technical topic within the domain, e.g. bgp_route_leak. 512 distinct values present.

difficulty.description: Sampled difficulty. Bounded per task_family by the taxonomy.

coordinates.description: The compositional taxonomy coordinate the prompt was generated to realize. See coordinates_fields.

taskgen_model.description: Model that authored the prompt text.

language.description: Optional in the schema; ABSENT from every record in this file.

coordinates_fields.taxonomy_id: Taxonomy that defines the axes. Constant `scogo-enterprise-netops-v2`.
coordinates_fields.category_id: Mirrors the top-level `category`. Verified equal in all 4,010 records.
coordinates_fields.task_family: What kind of work the task demands (RCA, telemetry interpretation, config review, next-best-action, change/rollback, abstention, architecture).
coordinates_fields.environment: Where the scenario sits (campus, branch, data_center, hybrid, cloud, multicloud, kubernetes, remote_access, enterprise_wireless, ot, ai_hpc, edge, lab_staging).
coordinates_fields.platform_scope: Enum: platform_neutral | single_platform | multi_platform. Constrains `platforms` cardinality to 0, 1, and 2 respectively.
coordinates_fields.platforms: Array of vendor/platform ids, unique. Empty for platform_neutral.
coordinates_fields.incident_mechanism: The underlying fault class the scenario encodes.
coordinates_fields.evidence_condition: Quality of the supplied evidence: sufficient | partial | contradictory | stale | missing_live_state. Non-`sufficient` values are deliberate — they test abstention and escalation.
coordinates_fields.evidence_bundle: Which artifact types are embedded in the prompt.
coordinates_fields.action_risk: How much action the task authorizes: read_only_investigation | advisory_plan_only | approval_gated_change | staging_or_simulation | emergency_change_decision.
coordinates_fields.presentation: Surface form / channel the prompt is written as.

validation.method: Field-by-field check of every record against schemas/task-v2.schema.json (required keys, no additional properties, types, enums, ranges, platform_scope/platforms cardinality, platforms uniqueness, category_id == category).
validation.note_difficulty_bounds: Every record's difficulty falls inside the per-task_family difficulty_min/difficulty_max declared in docs/netops-taxonomy.yaml. Zero violations.
validation.note_coordinate_uniqueness: 3,048 distinct coordinate tuples across 4,010 records. Unlike Part 1, coordinates are NOT unique here: 953 tuples are realized by more than one record (944 twice, 9 three times), covering 1,915 records (47.8%). Every repeat spans different runs; no run repeats a coordinate internally. See known_limitations for the cause.

in_pipeline.scope: Applied within each generation run against that run's accumulated corpus. Each of the three runs started from existing_records = 0, so no run deduplicated against the others.

post_merge_check.lexical_near_duplicate_scan: 5-gram Jaccard over all within-domain pairs (387,576 pairs)

same_coordinate_pair_scan.finding: Records that share a coordinate still produce lexically distinct scenarios — the generator did not repeat itself.

post_merge_check.caveat: The post-merge scan is lexical only and restricted to within-domain pairs. No cross-run embedding dedup pass was run, and no cross-part dedup against Part 1 was run. Lexical overlap is negligible, so near-duplicates are unlikely but not proven absent at the semantic level.

removed_during_merge.reason: The three source runs are pairwise disjoint at both record and prompt level. Straight concatenation; every source record is present.

same_coordinate_cross_part_pair_scan.comparison: Part 2 records vs Part 3 records sharing an identical coordinate tuple
same_coordinate_cross_part_pair_scan.finding: Records sharing a coordinate across parts are lexically unrelated — Parts 2 and 3 used different generator models. The shared coordinate is a topical constraint, not duplicated text.

cross_part_check.caveat: Coordinate overlap with Part 3 is real topical redundancy even though the text differs. If Parts 2 and 3 are combined, group by coordinate tuple before splitting train/test.

generator.coordinate_seed: 20260820 — the SAME seed for all three runs

quality_gate.outcomes: accept | revise | reject | needs_verification. Only `accept` records reach this file.
quality_gate.note: Reviewer is uniform across all 4,010 records and is a different model from the generator. `needs_verification` outcomes escalated to claim-level adjudication, which Part 1 never invoked. This is a stronger quality signal than Part 1 carries.

token_cost.note: Sum across all three contributing runs. All runs are fully represented in this file, so these totals are exact.

content.nature: Fully synthetic. Every config excerpt, log line, telemetry series, packet summary, hostname, IP, ticket id, and timestamp is a fictional scenario fixture.
content.no_live_access: Prompts must not imply live system access. Embedded evidence is supplied, not fetched.
content.pii: No personal data found. Hostnames, ticket ids, and timestamps are invented. Of 11,859 IPv4 mentions, 11,776 are private/documentation/reserved; the 83 globally-routable ones are documentation-adjacent addresses (198.51.101.x, just outside TEST-NET-2 198.51.100.0/24) plus well-known public infrastructure used as scenario anchors (Azure 168.63.129.16, GCP ranges 35.191.0.0, 130.211.0.0, 35.235.240.0). 21 email-like strings appear, all on RFC 2606 reserved domains (.example, .test, .invalid) or redacted GCP service-account identifiers.
content.secrets: Not audited exhaustively. Credential-shaped strings in configs are synthetic scenario fixtures, not live secrets. Do not treat any token in the corpus as valid.

prompt_length.note: No tokenizer was applied. As a rough guide, ~4 chars/token puts the corpus near 2.5M tokens.

distributions.note: Observed counts over all 4,010 records. Compare against the target weights in docs/netops-taxonomy.yaml.

platforms.note: Counts are mentions, not records: a multi_platform record contributes two.

known_limitations: All three source runs used the identical coordinate_seed (20260820) with existing_records = 0, so each run re-walked the same coordinate sequence from the start. Consequence: 952 of the c1000 run's 1,000 coordinate tuples are also realized in the c3000 run. 1,915 records (47.8%) sit on a coordinate shared with at least one other record. Scenario text is lexically distinct (max same-coordinate Jaccard 0.084), but topical redundancy is structurally built in. Future parts should advance the seed or resume from the prior corpus.

Shares coordinate_seed 20260820 with the Part 3 run as well as internally. 1,645 coordinate tuples are common to Parts 2 and 3, covering 2,169 Part 2 records (54.1%). Text is lexically unrelated across parts (max same-coordinate Jaccard 0.066), but the topical redundancy is structural if the parts are combined.
Single generator model (cx/gpt-5.6-luna-max) — stylistic and reasoning-pattern homogeneity is expected. No generator diversity within this part.
Single sampling temperature (0.9) for every record. Uniform, but no temperature-driven diversity sweep.
No cross-run semantic (embedding) dedup pass was run after the merge, and no dedup against Part 1. Lexical overlap is negligible; see deduplication.post_merge_check.caveat.

Observed axis distributions drift from taxonomy target weights. layer3_routing (300) and network_services (283) are over-represented relative to weight; enterprise_realtime_networking (34) and packet_protocol_foundations (39) are thin. rf_interference appears in only 13 records and ai_hpc in 43.

Difficulty skews harder than the taxonomy target: observed mean 6.12 with 26.2% of records at difficulty 8-10, against a target of 24% for that band; difficulty 1 is nearly absent (5 records vs a 2% target).

The c3000 run logged 206 generation request errors and 50 review errors against the endpoint (retried, not fatal). Records themselves are unaffected, but the run's throughput numbers reflect retry churn.
Prompts are unlabelled. There is no reference answer, rubric score, or difficulty ground truth to validate the sampled `difficulty` integer against.
No train/validation/test split is defined. If you split, group by coordinate tuple (not just domain+subdomain) so the 953 shared-coordinate groups do not straddle the split boundary.
Quality was judged by LLM review and LLM adjudication only. No human review pass has been performed on this part.
